rationale.consistency: Perfectly matches Caddy's directive registration, JSON unmarshaling, package layout, and wrapper patterns.
rationale.edge_cases: Safely handles time.Duration overflow, unit parsing, lack of SetDeadline support, and chunk boundaries.
rationale.scope: Implements all idle timeout and rate floor features exactly as requested without unrelated modifications.
rationale.readability: Cleanly abstracts deadline math, uses clear naming, and integrates well into the HTTP handlers.
rationale.robustness: Safe against panics, gracefully skips unsupported controllers, and reliably bounds chunked reads and writes.
rationale.maintainability: Decoupled timeout logic and cleanly modular middleware make future extensions and testing easy.
